description: This Dart source file defines an environment configuration class for a Flutter application. The class 'Env' provides static methods to load environment variables from a '.env' file and exposes getter methods to access various URLs, paths, and mode flags used throughout the application. It includes default fallbacks and error handling for missing or problematic environment configurations.

classes.name: Env
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to load and access environment variables for configuring the Flutter app.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads environment variables from the '.env' file, merging with minimal defaults, and falls back to test loading in case of errors.

methods.name: authLoginPath
methods.description: Returns the login path for authentication, defaulting to '/auth/login' if not set.

methods.name: mePaths
methods.description: Returns a list of user-specific endpoint paths, with defaults if not specified.

methods.name: apiBaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the API base URL, with a default fallback.

methods.name: realtimeUrl
methods.description: Returns the WebSocket URL for real-time data, with a default fallback.

methods.name: eventsUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL for events API, with a default fallback.

methods.name: mockMode
methods.description: Returns a boolean indicating if mock mode is enabled, supporting multiple truthy string representations.
